items.question: Which ritual objects are to be worshipped at dawn following the prescribed directional leaf offerings?
premises: dawn follows the preceding directional rites
the image and related objects are worshipped
pots and fires are also worshipped
items.inference: the rite prescribes dawn worship of the image, pots, and fires
uncertainties: the exact scope of bimbādyaṃ beyond image and related objects is not specified
items.plain_english: Then at dawn one should worship the image and the rest, the pots, and the fires.
